(2) The EI isolation exemptions are honest scoping: the capped pair (26617, 49900) is one shared display cap over two independently computed figures, months[0] is built from the anchors before the cliff block exists (src/lib/forecast.ts:239 to 277), and the fixture sweep pins I1 under layoff; the state differing pair is a boundary display coincidence, documented weakly per the second Low. (3) The ForecastEiCliff additive fields (afterDeciMonths, afterMonthIndex, afterLabel, continuation) are computed with the judge runway and integer ceiling division in forecast.ts and consumed only as finished display numbers, which is what keeps the components money math free; the headline exclusion tests (forecast.test.ts:461 and 482) pin that they never feed months[0].
+
+Verified clean: the balance projection is integer cents with no float in the lib (forecast.ts:232 to 234); every month answer is shocks.runway over that month's balance (forecast.ts:242) and the worst case branch uses the same function (forecast.ts:314); landfall is integer ceiling division (forecast.ts:189); the horizon is 12 default, extended to the landfall month, capped at 120 (forecast.ts:197 to 202); the storm front appears only when the twist differs from IDLE_TWIST (forecast.ts:259); the EI cliff is visible only for twist.jobLoss and the dashed continuation never reaches the headline; components hold zero money math (stripLayout and all strip arithmetic are pixel mapping only); one derivation pass in ConsoleView.tsx:48 to 65; consoleStore.ts has zero diff at HEAD; shockParse, TypedShock, and ShockChips are untouched; no new fetches; the history anchor note, the Beyond the answer key label, and recorded provenance copy are all present and honest; tests pin exact integer cents throughout (the only toBeCloseTo is on pixel slot width at ForecastStrip.test.ts:183) and read the shipped profiles.json and golden fixtures rather than tautological mocks; commit 1e3426e (conditional skip for raw-CSV tests) exists and is out of this review's scope.
+
+Recurring patterns: the dash scan registry lagging modified files (second cycle: tailwind.config.js in E2, weather.css in E3), and test exemptions documented for one case while silently covering a second (the cap exemption comment does not mention the state differing pairs).
